cd.title: first songs
cd.situation: Open mic night outside the shop. Mira is up next, but the crowd is glued to their phones and she has lost her nerve.
cd.today: Mira's 'first songs' went gold. She still opens the shop's open mic night every March.

actions.label: picked up Mira's dropped demo CD
actions.line: A scratched demo CD on the bench: 'MIRA - first songs', in silver marker. She must have dropped it.

actions.label: played it at the shop's listening post
actions.prompt: Play it at the listening post
actions.line: The owner turns the listening post right up. Phones go down. 'Who IS this?' Mira grins, grabs the mic and plays it live.
actions.lockedLine: The listening post is free, but you've got nothing worth playing. Didn't someone drop a CD by the bench?

offline.headline: The Open Mic Nobody Was Watching
offline.article: On 14 March 2004 a stranger played Mira's dropped demo at Hollow Records' listening post, and a bored open-mic crowd put their phones away to listen. Her debut 'first songs' has just gone gold, and its disc hangs by the shop door.
